summary: Beltrami County state tower 121, an 80-foot ladder tower in Kelliher. A 2025 compilation says it was damaged in removal, as hearsay.

events.note: Survey note records a sighting on the top of the fire tower in the west part of Kelliher

evidence.quote: State tower number 121. Kelliher was located in town at SW NW S35-T152-R32.
It was an 80 foot ladder tower.

notes_for_editor: Two sources only. The compilation gives no build year and no coordinates for Kelliher; it places the tower in town (SW NW S35-T152-R32). Its removal account is introduced as hearsay ('Word is'), and the story says so. The record's coordinates (47.94126, -94.45554) could not be checked against the compilation. Searches found no newspaper or other source on this tower. The 1906 Kelliher water tower (Bemidji Pioneer report) is a different structure and is not used. Staffing and fires: nothing found, so none in the story. Possible local records, not checked: North Beltrami Heritage Center in Kelliher; Beltrami County Historical Society in Bemidji.
